mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS definition_id, v.id AS version_id, v.name, v.description, v.descriptor->>'tool_name' AS tool_name, p.deployment_key, p.provider_type, p.provider_ref, p.environment FROM nw_tool_deployments p JOIN nw_capability_versions a ON a.id=p.tool_version_id JOIN nw_capability_definitions d ON d.id=a.definition_id AND d.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM a.tenant_id AND d.capability_type=a.capability_type JOIN nw_capability_versions v ON v.id=d.default_version_id AND v.definition_id=d.id AND v.tenant_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM d.tenant_id AND v.capability_type=d.capability_type WHERE p.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND p.status='ACTIVE' AND p.provider_type IN ('MCP','PLATFORM') AND (a.tenant_id=#{tenant} OR (a.tenant_id IS NULL AND a.status='PUBLISHED')) AND (d.tenant_id=#{tenant} OR d.tenant_id IS NULL) AND d.capability_type='TOOL' AND d.status='PUBLISHED' AND v.status='PUBLISHED' AND v.descriptor->'model_invocable'='true'::jsonb AND v.descriptor->'confirmation_policy'='"NEVER"'::jsonb ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC, p.id DESC
